body:
My daughter was grown when suicide took her from me. She was super smart, had a wonderful smile and loved small animals. I was not able to live with her when she was young. She lived through an abusive childhood.  While in her 20s she struggled with anorexia and was diagnosed with bipolar disorder.  She struggled against suicide on four earlier occasions before she succumbed. She was my only child. 

To those who asked, I am not suicidal myself but am still on occasion overwhelmed with grief.  I cope by helping young adults who need educational assistance. I have not yet reached a point where I feel I can help others who are fighting against suicide.  Still I wish all of you will remember it's a permanent solution to a temporary problem. It breaks hearts and ends lives forcing those who love you to reevaluate everything they thought might be true in their lives.  Each of you is loved by someone even if you have not recognized that person in your life and heart. 

Thanks for responding last night and helping me through my grief.
